# WhichCraft Brand Guidelines

## Voice & Tone

WhichCraft's voice is **straightforward, confident, and no-nonsense**. We don't oversell or use marketing fluff. We tell users exactly what the app does and why it's better than the alternatives.

**Key Principles:**

- **Direct:** Get to the point. No unnecessary words.
- **Confident:** We know what we built is good. No hedging.
- **Practical:** Focus on real benefits, not buzzwords.
- **Authentic:** Speak like a human, not a corporation.

**Examples:**

- ✅ "Your brewlist. Private and fast."
- ❌ "Experience the revolutionary way to discover and curate your personalized beer journey!"
- ✅ "Log tastings. Remember the good ones."
- ❌ "Unlock the power of sophisticated taste tracking with our innovative platform."

## Terminology

Consistency is key. Always use these terms:

| Term                 | Usage                                     |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| **Brewlist**         | The user's main collection of saved beers |
| **Tasting**          | A check-in or logging event               |
| **Brews / Beers**    | The beverages themselves                  |
| **Liked / Disliked** | User rating (thumbs up/down)              |

## Brand Personality

- **Simple over fancy:** Feature simplicity is a feature, not a limitation.
- **Privacy-first:** Your data stays yours. Always mention this.
- **Ad-free forever:** Not a trial. Not a premium feature. Forever.
- **Paid, never ad-supported:** The app is free today, with paid upgrades planned. Revenue comes from people choosing to pay for the app—never from ads or from selling data. Don't write copy that says the app costs money until it actually does.
- **Fast:** Built with native iOS tech, not bloated web wrappers.

## Sample Content

Use the following samples as a reference for writing marketing copy, app store descriptions, and promotional text.

### Promotional Text

Track the beers you drink. No ads, no feeds, no noise—just your brewlist. Private, fast, and simple. iCloud sync keeps your tastings yours.

**Alternative options:**

- Log every brew. Remember the good ones. No ads, no feeds, no BS. Your tastings stay private in iCloud. Fast, simple, and actually yours.
- Your brewlist, your way. Track beers without feeds or followers. Private iCloud sync, no ads ever, native iOS speed. Simple tools for serious drinkers.
- Remember which beers you liked. Log tastings in seconds, sync privately via iCloud, filter your brewlist however you want. No ads. No social feed. Just you.

### App Store Description

WhichCraft is the fastest way to track the beers you drink. No ads, no feeds, no noise—just you and your brewlist.

WHAT YOU GET

• Fast Search
Find any beer from a comprehensive catalog of hundreds of thousands of brews worldwide.

• Your Brewlist
Every tasting gets saved to your personal collection. Filter by liked, disliked, or browse everything you've tried. Sort by date, name, or rating—whatever makes sense to you.

• Log Tastings
Thumbs up or down. Add notes. That's it. We don't make you fill out a form or rate things on a 10-point scale. You tried a beer. You liked it or you didn't. Move on.

• Private by Design
Your tastings sync via iCloud. They're yours. We don't see them, we don't sell them, and we can't lose them in a data breach. Your brewlist lives in your iCloud account, not on some company's server.

• Actually Fast
Built with SwiftUI and SwiftData. Native iOS. No web wrappers, no lag, no waiting for things to load. Open the app, search, log, done.

• No Ads, Ever
We're not selling your attention to advertisers. The app is free to start, and anything we charge for will be the app itself—never your data. That's the business model. Clean and simple.

COMING SOON

• Location Tagging
Add the brewery, bar, or couch where you tried a beer. Build a map of your tasting history.

• Map View
See everywhere you've logged a tasting. Revisit your favorite spots or discover patterns in where you drink.

WHY WHICHCRAFT?

Because you shouldn't need a social network to remember which IPA you liked. You shouldn't have to scroll past ads to see your own data. And you definitely shouldn't trust a startup with your beer preferences when they're just going to get acquired and shut down in three years.

WhichCraft is simple, fast, and private. It does one thing well: helps you remember the beers you've tried so you can find them again or avoid them next time.

Download it. Log a few tastings. See if you like it. If you don't, we're not going to send you push notifications begging you to come back. We're not that kind of app.

REQUIREMENTS

• iOS 18 or later
• iCloud account (for syncing across devices)

SUPPORT

Questions? Issues? Email us at support@whichcraft.beer
We actually read our email.

### Keywords

**Keyword Strategy:**

- **Core terms:** beer, brewery, craft beer
- **Features:** brewlist, tasting, tracker, cellar
- **Competitors:** untappd (capture users searching for alternatives)
- **Styles:** IPA, ale (most searched styles)

```
beer,brewery,craft beer,IPA,brewlist,tasting,untappd,cellar,beer tracker,ale
```
